C-22.Name: Site engine + publish pipeline rework (mark.xronocode.com)
C-22.Summary: Review of the C-14 site (session 2026-09-26) found the build engine held together by a post-build `cp` of the landing over the VitePress home, a hard-coded `/mark/` base in ~20 places, two competing deploy targets (GitHub Pages workflow + Vercel config with a /mark rewrite), no SEO/share metadata, 404 logo/favicon in the docs, and no local way to see the real landing under `vitepress dev`. Rework the engine and the publish pipeline so the site can move to its own domain mark.xronocode.com and later gain analytics without further plumbing.

Problem.Description: Site build is fragile, path-bound to /mark/, double-deployed, and has no share/SEO head.
Problem.RootCause: Landing was generated outside VitePress (C-14 OpenDesign) and bolted on with a cp in CI.
Problem.Evidence: Live check 2026-09-26: /logo.png, /favicon.ico, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml 404; landing head has only charset+viewport; vercel.json + site.yml both build.

Goals.R-1: One build command (`npm run build` in site/) produces the complete site: VitePress docs + landing at the root, rendered by a VitePress buildEnd hook, not a CI cp.
Goals.R-2: Base path and canonical URL come from config (SITE_URL, SITE_BASE; default https://mark.xronocode.com and `/`); landing uses a base token, never a literal /mark/.
Goals.R-3: Shared head for landing and docs: description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter card, favicon; sitemap.xml, robots.txt and CNAME emitted into dist.
Goals.R-4: `vitepress dev` serves the real landing at the base root, so local preview matches production.
Goals.R-5: Opt-in analytics hook: when UMAMI_WEBSITE_ID is set, the cookieless Umami script is injected into landing and docs; unset means no third-party script at all (default).
Goals.R-6: Single deploy target: GitHub Pages via site.yml. vercel.json removed. PRs build + check without deploying; pushes to main build, check, deploy.
Goals.R-7: A dist checker fails the build on any unresolved internal link/asset, leftover base token, or missing sitemap/robots.

Constraints.Constraint: Download links stay derived from the live GitHub release API (C-14 constraint).
No analytics script ships unless explicitly configured.
Local only in this change: nothing is pushed; DNS and Pages custom-domain switch are user actions.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Landing copy/visual fixes (header logo overflow, GitHub icon, changelog refresh) — follow-up.
Choosing/creating the analytics account and updating privacy copy for it — follow-up once enabled.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `cd site && npm run build && npm run check` green locally; dist has index.html (landing), CNAME, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, no `/mark/` asset paths.
With SITE_BASE=/mark/ the same build still resolves every link (fallback for github.io).
Unit tests for landing rendering pass in the renderer vitest suite.

C-22.VerificationIntent: Unit tests for the landing renderer (base substitution, head injection, analytics on/off); dist checker as a CI gate; manual local preview.
